info.title: ModelRegistry API
info.description: Free unauthenticated read-only REST API for the open frontier AI model registry at https://modelregistry.tirup.in. No API keys, no signup. CORS-open (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *). Human-readable reference: https://modelregistry.tirup.in/docs. Every record carries provenance (sources, field-level citations, verification status, changelog); benchmark figures are lab-reported unless a model page shows otherwise. Revision policy: stable kebab-case record IDs; additive fields only within v1; breaking changes ship as v2. Dataset revisions are dated (see datasetVersion); record history at https://modelregistry.tirup.in/changelog.

get.description: Primary endpoint. Returns every tracked model plus a per-laboratory rollup. All query parameters are optional and combinable. Supports conditional requests: send the ETag back as If-None-Match to receive 304 when the dataset revision and filters are unchanged.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Laboratory id (e.g. openai, anthropic, google, deepseek).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Model bucket: flagship, reasoning, open-weights, code, multimodal, audio, image, video.

parameters.name: openWeights
parameters.description: "true" for downloadable weights, "false" for proprietary API models.

parameters.name: flagshipOnly
parameters.description: "true" returns exactly one primary flagship per laboratory.

parameters.name: latestOnly
parameters.description: "true" returns each lab's newest shipped checkpoint(s).

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag from a previous response. Returns 304 with an empty body when nothing changed.

200.description: Registry snapshot. Unknown filter values return 200 with an empty models list (total 0).

ETag.description: Revision + query hash. Echo as If-None-Match.

Last-Modified.description: Dataset revision date, not request time.

updatedAt.description: Last real data revision (YYYY-MM-DD), never the request time.

verification.description: Status counts over the returned models.

304.description: Not modified — dataset revision and filters unchanged since the ETag was issued.

get.description: Terminal-native view: primary flagships table plus recent specialized checkpoints. No parameters.

get.summary: Service health and dataset verification snapshot
get.description: Honest health signal. Upstream reachability (OpenRouter heartbeat) is reported separately and never implies factual verification; factual freshness comes only from per-record verification dates. Poll no more than once every 5 minutes.

generatedAt.description: Response generation time. Not a verification claim.

oldestVerificationDate.description: Oldest per-record source check in the dataset.

upstreamAvailability.description: Unrelated third-party reachability. Never read as registry verification.

get.description: JSON Feed 1.1 with the same items and ordering as /rss.xml, plus per-item verification status and record modification dates.
Newest-first release items with stable /models/:id GUIDs.
Per-lab flagships and checkpoints with dataset version and verification counts. Benchmark figures are lab-reported.
Every record with verification status, sources, and changelog pointers. Benchmark figures are lab-reported.

SourceRef.description: One cited primary source behind a record.

publishedAt.description: Source publication date, when directly observed.

accessedAt.description: Date the registry last confirmed the source.

live.description: True when the source returned HTTP 2xx to the automated check.

note.description: Access limits or source weaknesses, e.g. bot-gated pages.

ModelItem.description: One registry record. Benchmark figures are lab-reported, not independently reproduced.

isCompanyFlagship.description: Lab's primary general-purpose model. Requires fresh, live evidence.

isLatestCheckpoint.description: Lab's newest shipped release. Requires fresh, live evidence.

fieldSources.description: Per-field citations keyed by releaseDate, contextWindow, maxOutputTokens, parameters, license, pricing, modalities, benchmarks, isCompanyFlagship, isLatestCheckpoint. Missing keys mean no citable source yet.
